description: This file defines the ContactRepository class, which manages database operations related to 'contact' entities, including inserting new contacts, retrieving contacts by client ID, and deleting contacts by ID.

classes.name: ContactRepository
classes.description: A repository class responsible for CRUD operations on contact data within the database, implementing insert, find, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new Contact record into the database and returns the inserted record's ID.

methods.name: findByClientId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of contact records associated with a specific client ID.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a contact record from the database based on the provided contact ID.
